page_title: LEN 2-1 TOU | Lens v Toulouse 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+2' Kevin Danso (Lens) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+1' Kevin Danso (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+1' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Elye Wahi (Lens) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
89' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
88' Elye Wahi (Lens) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
85' That will be all from Florian Sotoca who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
84' 2 - 1 Goal! Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and fires the ball past the goalkeeper.
81' Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
78' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Cesar Gelabert Pina and he is replaced by Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Adrien Thomasson.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
75' Elye Wahi (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj had an easy-decision to make.
73' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
69' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
67' Here's the change. Denis Genreau leaves the pitch and Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
66' The free kick from long range, taken by Lens, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Florian Sotoca (Lens) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Andy Diouf will be replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
63' Elye Wahi (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wesley Said.
63' It's time for a substitution. Deiver Machado (Lens) comes on in place of Przemyslaw Frankowski.
61' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Frank Magri (Toulouse) replacing Thijs Dallinga.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Logan Costa (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Kevin Keben cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' Florian Sotoca (Lens) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
54' Caution goes to Jonathan Gradit (Lens).
53' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lens.

52' Florian Sotoca (Lens) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' The free kick from long range, taken by Lens, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

50' Facundo Medina (Lens) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
47' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
46' Half-time substitution. Warren Kamanzi is replaced by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle and it's Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+1' 1 - 1 What an outstanding solo effort by Wesley Said (Lens) as he weaves through the defence inside the box and rolls the ball into the back of net.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' Wesley Said (Lens) is penalised for a foul. Hakim Ben El Hadj had a clear view and blows his whistle.
44' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner kick, but Guillaume Restes reads it well and stops the effort.
43' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
41' Andy Diouf (Lens) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
41' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Lens get a corner.
39' Andy Diouf (Lens) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
39' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens).
35' Lens take a short corner kick.
35' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
33' 0 - 1 What a goal that is! Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) goes on a mazy run and from inside the box he beats Brice Samba with a delightful chip. He makes it 0:1.
31' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adrien Thomasson (Lens), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
26' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the right post.
25' It looks like Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) saw red with that tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
24' Florian Sotoca (Lens) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
21' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
18' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
17' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
14' Facundo Medina plays a beautiful lofted pass to Ruben Aguilar (Lens), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
10' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) commits a foul and Hakim Ben El Hadj immediately signals a free kick.
9' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
5' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' Crossbar! Adrien Thomasson (Lens) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range crashed against the crossbar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Hakim Ben El Hadj.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
